verses.original: לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ־ רִֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh rā·ḡə·šū ḡō·w·yim ū·lə·’um·mîm yeh·gū- rîq
verses.literal: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain

verses.original: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ׀ מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־ יָ֑חַד עַל־ יְ֝הוָה וְעַל־ מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū mal·ḵê- ’e·reṣ wə·rō·wz·nîm nō·ws·ḏū- yā·ḥaḏ ‘al- Yah·weh wə·‘al- mə·šî·ḥōw
verses.literal: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the LORD and against His Anointed One

verses.original: נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת־ מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃
verses.literal: Let us break Their chains and cast away . . . Their cords

verses.original: יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.literal: The One enthroned in heaven laughs the Lord taunts them

verses.original: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.literal: Then He rebukes them in His anger and terrifies them in His fury

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר־ קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî nā·saḵ·tî mal·kî ‘al- ṣî·yō·wn har- qāḏ·šî
verses.literal: I have installed My King on Zion upon My holy mountain

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: I will proclaim . . . the decree spoken to Me by the LORD You are My Son today I have become Your Father

verses.original: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’al mim·men·nî wə·’et·tə·nāh ḡō·w·yim na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā wa·’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯə·ḵā ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Ask Me and I will make the nations Your inheritance the ends of the earth Your possession

verses.original: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: tə·rō·‘êm bə·šê·ḇeṭ bar·zel kiḵ·lî yō·w·ṣêr tə·nap·pə·ṣêm
verses.literal: You will break them with an iron scepter You will shatter them like pottery . . .

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: Therefore be wise O kings be admonished O judges of the earth

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה׃
verses.literal: Serve the LORD with fear and rejoice with trembling

verses.original: נַשְּׁקוּ־ בַ֡ר פֶּן־ יֶאֱנַ֤ף׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־ יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל־ ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: naš·šə·qū- ḇar pen- ye·’ĕ·nap̄ wə·ṯō·ḇə·ḏū ḏe·reḵ kî- yiḇ·‘ar kim·‘aṭ ’ap·pōw ’aš·rê kāl- ḥō·w·sê ḇōw
verses.literal: Kiss the Son lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion when His wrath ignites in an instant Blessed are all who take refuge in Him
